points: Leave cheats off on your trophy save. Launch guides report that any cheat switches off trophy tracking and saving, and the only fix is a clean save.

GTA 6 has no mission replay and no New Game Plus, and 15 manual save slots plus one autosave. Keep one save at the start of every chapter and one untouched save from just before the final mission, and rotate the rest.
Turn the spoiler setting on in this guide until you want story names shown: hidden story trophies stay masked here until you tick them earned.
Tick trophies off in the checklist as you earn them, and export your progress to a file after each session so a lost save never costs you the list.
phases.title: Before you start

points: Play Gone Fishing, then Chapter 1. Before Chapter 1 ends, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house on a morning after Down to Earth: it is the one missable step in the whole list.
Finish Chapter 2. Switching between Jason and Lucia opens here, and with it the partner trophies.
Open the Scooter Bros app through the mission Moses and the Real Estate app after Daily Driver; both feed later trophies.
Start every stranger chain as soon as it unlocks. One guide warns the chains can have windows tied to story progress.
Visit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2 for Let's Go Bowling.
phases.title: Chapters 1 and 2 — the opening

points: Race Against Yago the moment it appears in Chapter 3: it is time-sensitive and counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
Take Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 for the Snap Gun, then rob a jewelry store unseen for Sneakthief.
Steal the docked jet at VCIA gates E3 or E4 for Catch Me If You Can, and the Rhino at Mile Zero Air Station for Challenging Tank.
Near the end of Chapter 4, take the optional mission That's Where The Money Is to unlock bank vaults, then rob vaults with your partner.
Rob three shops in a row with your partner for Retail Therapy, and lose a 4-star wanted level together for Hot Together.
phases.title: Chapters 3 and 4 — the middle

points: Keep a save from just before the final mission, then complete it for the second Gold.
The side-story finales for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone stay open after the credits, as do the hunting strand for Bret and the Strangers & Freaks strands.
Buy the eight garages, register ten cars, and launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts.
The 100% checklist appears now, under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. Everything you did earlier already counts.
phases.title: Finale and after the story

points: Work the long grinds with the trophy target first and the 100% target second; the table below shows both numbers.
Finish the shooting range golds, the drone race locations, the card sets, the WAiNK locations and the vehicle scans.
Complete 70 of the 80 Challenges and clear the fog from every corner of Leonida.
When the 100% checklist is done, A Long Road pops, and the Platinum follows with it. Launch guides put the whole run at roughly 200 hours.
phases.title: Cleanup and the Platinum
